config.phase_title: Synchronized EEG–QRNG Protocol and Gate-Sensitivity Validation

provenance.interpretation: Surrogate synchronized input: valid for pipeline validation, but not for an empirical EEG–QRNG claim.

feature_audit.interpretation: Feature audit passed: rebuilt features match the current windows table.

conditional_diagnostics.interpretation: Registered primary localized predictive support is present, but the current official global BIC gate is not satisfied.

control_diagnostics.interpretation: All required negative controls passed under the corrected control-specific classification.

gates.name: Injection recovery
gates.reason: not_evaluated_in_metrics; reserved for runner-level injection test

f7_subject_consistency.interpretation: The selected primary lead satisfies the adaptive F7 rule.

augmented_model_score.label: QRNG transition conditioned by multichannel EEG

f8_complexity_penalty.interpretation: The selected primary lead fails official BIC, while held-out likelihood and/or AIC provide weaker support. Complexity-scaled scenarios are diagnostic only and do not replace official BIC.

f12_epsilon_saturation.interpretation: F12 does not raise an official diagnostic saturation warning. Exploratory threshold scenarios remain diagnostic only.

gate_sensitivity_diagnostics.interpretation: F7/F8/F12 sensitivity diagnostics completed without changing official gates. F7 uses the adaptive selected-lead rule, F8 preserves BIC as official while reporting weaker complexity sensitivities, and F12 remains diagnostic.

final_interpretation.headline: A registered primary localized predictive lead was detected; only the current official global BIC gate remains unsatisfied.
final_interpretation.f8_failure_meaning: Lack of global BIC parsimony support; not proof that the localized predictive structure is absent.
final_interpretation.recommendation: Preserve the Phase III.2E v2 result as BIC-limited. A future v3 may prospectively re-evaluate F8 using effective sample size, effective complexity, state-density correction or subject-level selection, before any real-data analysis.
